description: platform-neutral with a grain texture, which raises the targets on canvas and surfaces by 10%, and a signature fill from the accent itself, which reads at 3:1 on warm-parchment's light surfaces but not at the 3.3:1 the texture sets. anchor-v2 solves signature-start to the raised target, and this fill skips it.

tokens.texture: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 12%, transparent) 0 0.5px, transparent 0.75px)
